name: Testimonials
summary: Passive container-responsive collection of native attributed quotations with optional canonical Avatar composition.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Title-labelled thematic section or untitled generic root for one valid passive quotation collection.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Optional visible contextual heading that names the thematic root.

anatomy.name: grid
anatomy.description: Required native unordered list of valid attributed quotations.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: Repeated native list item that owns placement and target editor metadata.

anatomy.name: testimonial
anatomy.description: Native figure that relates one quotation to its attribution.

anatomy.name: quoteMark
anatomy.description: Optional target-localized decorative opening quotation mark explicitly hidden from assistive technology.

anatomy.name: quote
anatomy.description: Native block quotation containing non-empty target-authored quoted words.

anatomy.name: author
anatomy.description: Native figure caption that attributes the quotation outside its quoted content.

anatomy.name: avatar
anatomy.description: Optional complete canonical Avatar with target-authored image or initials semantics.

anatomy.name: identity
anatomy.description: Neutral wrapper that keeps visible author name and optional supporting detail grouped.

anatomy.name: name
anatomy.description: Required visible non-empty author name; it is text rather than the title-of-work cite element.

anatomy.name: detail
anatomy.description: Optional visible author role, location, organization, or other concise context.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Single intrinsic size whose one, two, or three-column density is private root-container composition.

states.name: default
states.description: Populated passive quotation collection with no focus, animation, live-region behavior, or neutral runtime.

behavior.name: rootSemantics
behavior.description: A non-empty title produces a thematic section named by its visible heading; an untitled collection uses a generic root rather than an unnamed section.

behavior.name: nativeCollection
behavior.description: The repeated collection uses native ul/li semantics and preserves target source order across responsive columns without redundant list roles.

behavior.name: quoteAttribution
behavior.description: Each native figure contains a non-empty blockquote and an external figcaption with a visible author name; a person's name is not marked up as cite.

behavior.name: decorativeQuoteMark
behavior.description: The optional quotation mark is target-localized or omitted and is always excluded from the accessibility tree.

behavior.name: canonicalAvatarComposition
behavior.description: Optional Avatar consumes the canonical passive dependency; when the same identity is visible beside it, native image alt is empty and initials are aria-hidden.

behavior.name: targetRecordOwnership
behavior.description: Targets own records, ordering, source URLs, verification, consent, moderation, localization, publication, image delivery, loading, empty, error, and update policy.

behavior.name: omission
behavior.description: Targets omit records missing non-empty quote or visible author name and omit the complete root when no valid record remains.

behavior.name: responsiveComposition
behavior.description: One, two, or three columns respond to the component root's inline space without viewport or Studio overrides, visual reordering, or clipped content.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Optional non-empty visible contextual heading; when present it names the thematic root.

properties.name: items
properties.description: One or more target-owned native list-item compositions, each containing a complete figure, non-empty blockquote, external attribution, and visible author name.

accessibility: When title is present, render a thematic section associated with the visible contextual heading through aria-labelledby; use a generic root when title is absent.
Render parallel testimonials as a native ul/li list and preserve target source order across responsive columns.
Use figure with blockquote and external figcaption so quoted words remain distinct from attribution; do not use cite for a person's name.
Require a visible non-empty author name even when Avatar is present; adjacent redundant Avatar images use empty alt and adjacent redundant initials are aria-hidden.
Hide the optional decorative quotation mark with aria-hidden and allow targets to localize or omit it.
Do not add list-widget roles, focus stops, keyboard behavior, auto-rotation, live regions, motion, or neutral runtime to the passive collection.
Omit invalid records and the empty collection rather than exposing blank quotations, unnamed authors, or empty list/section structures.
Leave record verification, consent, moderation, source, legal disclosure, update announcements, and child Avatar lifecycle with their owning targets.

web.notes: Implemented by conditional titled-section semantics, a native list of figure/blockquote/figcaption items, canonical optional Avatar composition, intrinsic container-responsive CSS, strict required-slot omission, and no neutral runtime.

shopify.notes: Merchant section maps valid blocks to the canonical native quotation anatomy with optional heading, editor attributes, target-native image delivery, localized schema metadata, and zero component runtime.
